deferred_hardware.basis: The R8 target uses the same shared ESP32-S3 RNG/ADC TRNG bootstrap and identity-generation path exercised on the physical S3R2 V4, and its board-specific release build passes, but no physical R8 hardware is presently available for the signed candidate.
deferred_hardware.follow_up: Capture and review an S3R8 full-erase first boot, fresh node and Auto-BLE identity creation, identity retention after reboot, LoRa readiness, and stable-runtime observation after promotion.
